method: Retain every original imported clip and append 18 uniquely named full-source-take variants in one temporary import. Three source takes, six variants each, sampled at normalized .2/.5/.8 using a disposable root Humanoid Animator and HumanPoseHandler. Actor is origin, yaw 90 (+X), no controller/root motion/foot IK/playable IK/physics. Nested Animators removed. Finally restore the original ModelImporterClipAnimation array, reimport and verify original clip GUID/local IDs and removal of all temporary clips.
variantSelection: For each take: the four keepOriginalOrientation true/false x lockRootRotation true/false combinations at offset 0; then keepOriginalOrientation=false, lockRootRotation=true with offsets +representativeYaw and -representativeYaw. RepresentativeYaw is +57 degrees for SwordSlash/MagicCast, -24 for Throw, based on prior raw sideview diagnostics. All variants use each default take's full first/last frames, rather than any subsequently trimmed import interval.
humanPoseInterpretation: humanPoseBodyRotation and humanPoseForward store HumanPoseHandler.GetHumanPose output directly. humanPoseYawFromActorForward treats that rotation as world space. An explicit root-local interpretation (actor.rotation * pose.bodyRotation) is also recorded, alongside Animator.bodyRotation yaw, so coordinate-space differences are visible rather than silently assumed. Yaw is SignedAngle(actor.forward, planar body forward, up).
